claim_boundary: The theorem requires a finite explicit perfect-recall tree and a zero-sum payoff. It does not compact an exponentially large history tree, handle imperfect recall, or choose an admissible interface.

theorem.compiler: realization constraints E_i r_i=e_i and chance-weighted sequence payoff matrix A
theorem.consequence: hidden extensive games can be certified without enumerating complete pure strategies
theorem.input: finite two-player zero-sum extensive tree with rational chance, typed information sets, and perfect recall
theorem.max_certificate: E_max x=e_max and E_min^T p <= A^T x
theorem.min_certificate: E_min y=e_min and E_max^T q >= A y
